subject: IRS
category: The Biography of Muhammad
question: Establish four ways in which the Hijrah contributed to the growth of Islam.
modelAnswer: The Hijrah contributed significantly to the growth of Islam: 1. Establishment of the first Islamic state in Madinah. 2. Spread of Islam in Madinah and beyond. 3. Formation of the Muslim community (Ummah) uniting Muhajirun and Ansar. 4. Military and political strength with Madinah as a secure base. 5. The Charter of Madinah established a pluralistic society. 6. Beginning of the Islamic calendar.

subject: IRS
category: Life and Achievements of the Khulafa Rashidūn
question: Highlight and elucidate on five reasons responsible for the emergence of Abu Bakr as the first Orthodox Caliph.
modelAnswer: Abu Bakr emerged as the first Caliph because: 1. His close companionship with the Prophet. 2. The Prophet appointed him to lead prayers during his illness. 3. His knowledge and wisdom. 4. His character and integrity — called 'al-Siddiq.' 5. The consensus of the Companions. 6. His financial sacrifices for Islam.

subject: IRS
category: Islamic Marriage and Divorce and Comparison with Marriage and Divorce Practices in Other Cultures
question: Examine critically some conditions that could necessitate polygamy in Islam.
modelAnswer: Conditions necessitating polygamy: 1. Infertility of the first wife. 2. High number of widows and orphaned women. 3. Requirement for more help in agricultural or economic activities. 4. Long absence of the husband. 5. Personal desire for procreation. 6. Custom and tradition. Justice is the fundamental condition (Qur'an 4:3).

subject: IRS
category: The Islamic Concept of Ibadah
question: The term 'Ibadah' in Islamic Studies has a wide application. Do you agree? Give reasons.
modelAnswer: Yes, Ibadah has wide application. It encompasses all acts pleasing to Allah: 1. Not limited to rituals — includes all lawful actions. 2. Includes spiritual and physical actions. 3. Intention (Niyyah) makes any action worship. 4. Life itself is worship. 5. Comprehensive guidance in all aspects. 6. Types: physical, financial, and combined.

subject: IRS
category: A Study of the Text, Translation, and Interpretation of the Juz' 'Amma
question: Write either in Arabic or Transliteration Sūratul-Asr, comment on it and discuss its lessons.
modelAnswer: Sūratul-Asr (Chapter 103): 'By time, indeed, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to truth, and enjoin one another to patience.' Lessons: importance of time, faith and action, mutual encouragement, community responsibility.

subject: IRS
category: Authenticity of the Qur'an as a Divine Book
question: Identify and explain five points to make a case that the Qur'an is the original word of Allah.
modelAnswer: Five points: 1. The challenge of the Qur'an — no one can produce a chapter like it. 2. Scientific miracles confirmed by modern science. 3. Fulfilled prophecies. 4. Perfect language and eloquence. 5. No contradictions despite 23 years of revelation. 6. Perfect preservation. 7. Historical accuracy.

subject: IRS
category: Textual Analyses of an-Nawawī's Collection
question: Write either in Arabic or transliteration the Hadith seven of an-Nawawī and translate it into English, comment on it and discuss its lessons.
modelAnswer: Hadith Seven: 'Religion is sincerity.' To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders, and the common people. Lessons: sincerity is the core of religion, Muslims must be sincere in all relationships, and have responsibility to advise leaders and care for the community.

subject: IRS
category: A Critical Appraisal of Sahīh al-Bukhārī
question: Discuss the biography and contributions of Imam al-Bukhārī to the development of Hadīth.
modelAnswer: Imam al-Bukhari (194-256 AH) compiled Sahih al-Bukhari, the most authentic Hadith collection. Contributions: 1. Spent 16 years compiling Sahih al-Bukhari with strict criteria. 2. Established Hadith methodology. 3. Classified Hadith into Sahih, Hasan, Da'if. 4. Preserved the Sunnah. 5. Influenced Islamic scholarship. 6. Taught many students.
